findings.finding: From the company's own releases, Q3 2026 carried only the NOK 5.75m July placement against a Q2 operating burn of NOK 11.1m with two trials running, so the 30.09 cash figure should come in around NOK 15-18m, i.e. roughly two quarters of runway before H1 2027 readouts, which keeps continued equity-line drawing (and the report's financing language) in front of holders.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Results days are mostly sold: 9 of 12 observed NewsWeb results days negative, last four -4.5, -0.5, +3.2, -4.5; the Q3 2025 report (-4.1%) was followed two days later by a Long State draw (2025-11-28).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the inputs are all public and the stock has drifted from 0.13 to 0.10 since early October on falling volume, which is what an anticipated dilution path looks like. What would be unpriced is only the exact burn and any explicit runway date; if the market had fully discounted a tight runway the stock would not have bounced 5% off its 0.098 low into the print.
findings.independence: The October draw at NOK 0.13 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684051) shows the company already needed to draw within three weeks of the H1 report; same issuer, different document.

'Reaction history moves p_up, not abs_move': p_up 45 -> 44 on 9 of 12 negative results days
'Financing is a question': asked what the money buys (two trials to H1 2027 readouts, no revenue ramp to corroborate); kept the sign negative but trimmed -0.6 -> -0.5 as an inference on public inputs
